look_here_first: Treat as a nursery/lookalike comparison: pinnate evergreen leaves with many holly-like leaflets and blue-purple berry clusters. It is not native to Texas under the current Kew concept.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Current Kew native range is southwestern Canada to northern California; Texas is excluded.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Unlike the Central Texas natives, current B. aquifolium is a western species and not Texas-native.
